summary: Deep winter. Eat from stores, plan the year, order seeds.
tasks: Order seeds and plan this year's crop rotation
Check stored onions, potatoes & squash; remove any rot

summary: Still frozen. Chillies, onions and leeks start indoors under lights.
tasks: Sharpen and clean tools before the season starts

summary: Peak indoor sowing. Snow lingers and beds stay frozen.
tasks: Prepare beds and add compost once the snow's gone and soil is workable
Keep sowing tomatoes, brassicas & onions indoors

summary: Soil thaws from ~20 April. Onion sets, first hardy sowings, chit potatoes.
tasks: Harden off hardy seedlings (onions, brassicas) on the sheltered deck
Watch the forecast — frost is still likely here
Greenhouse: harden off seedlings and grow on early sowings
Chit seed potatoes on a bright, cool sill (10–15°C) for a few weeks before planting
Force rhubarb under a bucket once the buds show

summary: Plant potatoes. Tender crops go out once frost passes, late May.
tasks: Keep fleece handy for late frosts
Mulch beds to lock in moisture
Greenhouse: your 18 slots fill up now as summer crops go in
Harden off tender seedlings on the sheltered deck before planting out after the last frost

summary: Long light, fast growth. Weed, feed, train tomatoes.
tasks: Side-shoot tomatoes and feed weekly
Hoe weeds while they're still small
Greenhouse: water daily, feed weekly, ventilate, and side-shoot & train tomatoes

summary: Peak season. Water, pick, lift garlic.
tasks: Water deeply in dry spells
Dry and store lifted garlic somewhere airy
Greenhouse: peak cropping — keep picking, and damp down in the heat

summary: Main harvest. Sow green manure, order autumn sets.
tasks: Order garlic and overwintering onion sets
Sow green manure on cleared beds
Greenhouse: keep picking; strip lower tomato leaves for airflow & ripening

summary: First frosts from ~20 Sept. Plant garlic, harvest and cure for storage.
tasks: Cure onions fully before storing
Have fleece ready as frost approaches
Greenhouse: clear & scrub emptying slots as they finish
Plant garlic so it roots before the ground freezes
Move tender pots into the frost-free conservatory before the first frost

summary: Clear and mulch beds; store the last crops before the freeze.
tasks: Clear spent crops and add them to the compost
Mulch bare beds or sow green manure
Lift hardy roots (carrots, beetroot, parsnips) into sand boxes before the freeze
Greenhouse: clear spent crops & scrub down before it freezes

summary: Hard frosts begin. Greenhouse empty, garden put to bed.
tasks: Mulch and fleece overwintering crops (garlic, onions)
Drain & store hoses and water butts before they freeze and crack
Clean, oil and store tools
Greenhouse: clear it — unheated, it freezes solid now

summary: Dark and frozen. Eat from stores, plan next year, dream of seeds.
tasks: Plan next season and order seeds
Grow microgreens on the windowsill
